data.narrative:
Aurelius Systems is a Seed-stage frontier-technology company in the Defense & Security sector, having raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparison universe of 10 private peers and 2 public companies in the same sector and stage cohort, including private companies such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $25M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-or-adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $212M. The wide dispersion between methods reflects material uncertainty regarding stage-appropriate value attribution in early-stage frontier defense technology. Stage-progression assumes modest near-term maturation; peer-median reflects heterogeneous funding histories and technology differentiation within the cohort. Key uncertainties include technology validation, regulatory pathway clarity, and customer concentration risk typical of seed-stage defense companies. Further diligence on technical defensibility and go-to-market traction would narrow the range.
